Description: Consistent willingness and ability to alter attitudes, thoughts, and behaviors to appropriately respond to actual or anticipated change in the environment.
Ability to direct and sustain attention on a deliberately chosen target, tolerate sustained attention even when unpleasant, and maintain awareness of own attention.
Thinking about your own thinking; using cognitive strategies to monitor/self-regulate learning and other mental processes.
Understanding the problem space, generating possible solutions, and applying complex strategies to achieve (or move toward achieving) a specific goal.
Understanding connections (i.e. among people, places, and events) in order to anticipate their trajectories, estimate the overall situation, and act effectively.
